sloka: वैदेह्या चोद्यमानस्तु लक्ष्मणो दीनचेतनः ।अवाङ्मुखो बाष्पकलं वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह ।। ७.४७.१० ॥
transliteration: vaidehyā codyamānastu lakṣmaṇo dīnacetanaḥ ।avāṅmukho bāṣpakalaṁ vākyametaduvāca ha ।। 7.47.10 ॥

translations.english: Being urged by Sita, Lakshmana, with a sorrowful mind and downcast face, spoke these words in a voice choked with tears.
